rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's account 内閣総理大臣の指名, dated 26 December 2012, says that on the afternoon of that day both Houses held the designation vote and 安倍晋三 was designated as the 96th Prime Minister (63rd person) counted from Itō Hirobumi.
